name: Qwen Image 2.1 Viggle Turbo — 4 steps
description:
The same Qwen Image 2.1 you already have, running in FOUR sampling steps instead of twenty-five. Viggle distilled the full model into a student that reaches a comparable picture in a fraction of the passes, and that student is applied here as an adapter on top of the base weights.

Use it when you want to iterate — trying compositions, testing prompts, letting a room full of people generate. Use the plain Qwen Image 2.1 bundle when the picture matters more than the wait.

Prompt it exactly like the base model: full sentences, and any words you want rendered in "quotes" with a note on where they go.

★ Known limits, from Viggle’s own notes: this is a PREVIEW. It still falls short of the full model on multi-reference composition, face swaps and identity-preserving edits, and small or long stretches of rendered text can garble. Steps above 4 do not help — the schedule is baked in — and there is no negative prompt (guidance is fixed at 1).

⚠ Licence: Qwen Research License — research and evaluation only, no commercial use. The base Qwen Image 2.1 on this machine carries the same licence, so this changes nothing about what was already installed, but it is worth knowing before a commission.
